record.reason: The paper studies intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing (latent adversarial variants and low-rank alignment), with experiments on edit reliability/generalization. It does not propose an inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, or serving optimization; the linked MoE-LLaVA relation is only an MLLM application/architecture context.
record.title: Beyond Binary Edits Robust Multimodal Knowledge Editing with Adversarial Subspace Alignment
